item.title: Week 11: Colts at Texans
item.description: Thu 11/19 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: HOU -12.5 · O/U 44.5 | Model HOU 62% vs. market 85% | Indianapolis needs Daniel Jones protected against a Houston pass rush that arrives on 23% of dropbacks, since Jones struggles badly once pressure arrives. Jones ranks 29th among quarterbacks while C.J. Stroud sits 5th, a gap that widens every time Houston's pass rush forces a bad throw. Our model gives Houston 62% to the market's 85%, with the passing matchup and the starting quarterback pulling our number lower.
